      Fri 306:30 AM

      Friday, October 30 · 6:30 AM

      The 6:30 Decree

      Half past six on Friday morning. Mommy Brains will be up, dressed, and ready, and Kelly will be the one at the wheel. What follows is a full account of the morning, with a map.

      Article I

      The Proclamation

      A Proclamation of the Road

      By Order of Kelly

      Hear this, all who dwell along the road. It is decreed that Mommy Brains shall be awake, dressed, and ready, with her bag packed and her sensible shoes upon her feet, at half past six in the morning on Friday, the thirtieth of October.

      Kelly shall do the driving. The blue car shall set out at the appointed minute, and punctuality shall be greatly admired.

      KellyPosted by the household, this very week

      Article II

      The Rising

      Mommy Brains rises in 00:00:00
      Kelly's blue car departs in 00:00:00

      The Ritual of Rising

      1. The alarm tolls.The alarm sounds. No snooze.
      2. Coffee.Or tea. A quiet kitchen helps.
      3. Dressed, sensible shoes.Ready, and five minutes early to be ready.
      4. Bag by the door.Packed, zipped, and standing guard.
      5. On the porch, coat on.Watching the road with great composure.
      6. Kelly sets out.The blue car pulls up to the door.
